title: Recruiting coordinator daily scratchpad - 2026-03-04
content:
Morning priorities:
- Confirm interviewers for Chen Lu (Data Engineer) 10:30am PT — still waiting on Riley (sent ping).
- Follow up with Maya Rodriguez re: take-home test submission (deadline today).
- Block prep time 2-2:45pm for debrief + notes for Priya Singh panel.

Open tasks / quick checklist:
[ ] Send confirmation + directions to Ethan Brooks (onsite) — remind to bring ID.
[ ] Resend interview packet to Priya (panel updated) — include Rubric doc link.
[ ] Post updated interview time slots for next week to #recruiting-calendar.
[ ] Check offer approval status for candidate from last week (JIRA-RECRUIT-452).

Candidate follow-ups (action items):
- Maya Rodriguez: email reminder at EOD if no submission. Template: "Quick reminder — take-home due today, let me know if you need an extension."
- Chen Lu: confirm interviewer availability or move to backup panel (if Riley cannot make). If reschedule, propose Thu 11-12 or Fri 3-4.
- Ethan Brooks: taxi reimbursement note + parking pass instructions (onsite). Confirm arrival time 9:45am.
- Priya Singh: send Google Meet link + panel list (Riley, Samir, Jeff). Attach scoring rubric.

Today’s schedule (blocks):
- 9:00am - 9:30am: Inbox triage — candidate replies + slack.
- 9:30am - 10:15am: Interview coordination + calendar updates.
- 10:30am - 11:30am: Chen Lu interview (remote).
- 12:00pm - 1:00pm: Lunch + quick sync with recruiting PM.
- 2:00pm - 2:45pm: Priya panel debrief and notes.
- 3:00pm - 4:00pm: Scheduling for next week + open req follow-ups.

Reschedules / conflicts to resolve:
- Riley flagged OOO 10:15-11:00 — may impact Chen Lu panel. If Riley unavailable, swap with Samir (told Samir via DM, awaiting reply).
- Jeff tentative for Priya panel — send calendar hold and ask for confirmation by noon.

Notes to self / reminders:
- Keep candidate comms short and friendly — include "next steps" and expected timeline.
- Update interview packet after Priya debrief — note any rubric adjustments.
- Sync with People Ops manager about offering cadence for Data Eng roles (weekly meeting Thu).

Templates (quick copy-paste):
- Confirmation email (interview): "Hi [Name], confirming your interview on [date/time]. Meeting link: [link]. If you need to reschedule, reply to this email and we can find another time. Looking forward to speaking! — Avery"
- Follow-up ask (take-home): "Hi [Name], quick reminder that the take-home is due today. If you need more time, let me know and we can arrange an extension. Thanks!"

Unresolved questions / to check later:
- Is parking validated for onsite candidates this month? (ask facilities)
- Has offer approval SLT changed for Senior hires? (confirm with hiring manager)

End-of-day wrap:
- Send debrief notes for Priya to hiring manager + interviewers.
- Mark completed items and move pending to tomorrow's scratchpad.

-- quick log: 09:05 sent ping to Riley (Slack), 09:18 scheduled tentative hold for Priya panel, 09:22 added JIRA-RECRUIT-452 to follow-up list.
